_comment_1: Copy this file to ~/.pi/agent/slack-mcp.json (NOT stowed; per-machine secrets).
_comment_2: Use exactly one auth method below. An explicit env credential is authoritative and never mixed with inherited SLACK_MCP_* credentials; priority within one source is XOXP > XOXB > XOXC+XOXD.
_comment_timeout: Per-tool-call timeout (ms, default 60000). Raise globally and/or per upstream tool for slow calls like conversations_unreads over many channels.
_comment_postprocess: CSV output cleanup (default on). maxTextLength is per message; maxResponseChars is the whole processed response budget. Rows omitted by a response budget are reported explicitly. Dropping Cursor preserves it with a conspicuous incomplete-results footer. Per-call controls: _maxTextLength, _maxResponseChars, _maxRows, _includePermalink, and _raw.
